Class SwerveInputs

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.swerve.SwerveInputs
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoggableInputs
public class SwerveInputs extends Object implements LoggableInputs
Everything the drivetrain reads from CTRE in one loop, as an AdvantageKit input.

The CTRE SwerveDrivetrain still runs a 250 Hz odometry thread and the swerve requests. None of the robot's logic reads its pose directly. Instead, every odometry sample it produced since the last loop is queued off its thread and recorded here, and PoseFusion integrates them on the main loop. That is what makes the robot pose replayable: in replay these arrays come back from the log, the fusion re-runs over them, and every vision gate sees the same pose it saw on the field.

Odometry samples are stored flattened: module m of sample s is at index s * 4 + m.
